name: Nadiyadi Mix
ingredients_raw: Gram Flour(25%), Edible Vegetable Oil, Rice Flakes(6%), Sugar(6%), Gram Pulse (4%), Green Gram(4%), Red Lentil (Masoor)(4%), Coriander (3%), Anise(3%), Cumin (3%), Chilli Powder, Turmeric Powder, Compounded Asafetida, lodized Salt, Black Salt, Sesame Seeds, Black Pepper, Cloves, Star Anise, Nutmeg, Cardamom, Large Cardamom, Ginger Powder, Mesua Ferrea, Caraway, Dry Mango Powder, Acidity Regulator (E BEFORE 330), Raising Agent (E 500ii).
